title: Legacy 'Admin / Administrator' users become 'Administrator' after migration
custom_preconds:
1. Migration to the new roles is complete.
  2. At least one existing 'Admin / Administrator' user is present.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings > Staff and find a 'Admin / Administrator' user.
  2. Check the user's assigned role.
  3. Go to Settings > Roles & Permissions and find that role's row.
  4. Look at the role's read-only Permission Summary (eye icon).
custom_expected:
The user's role is 'Administrator'.

The role's permissions match the expected set for that role.

The 'Administrator' role is editable (it has a pencil icon).

The Administrator role is editable, except it cannot be changed to lose access to the admin pages. Only Office User and Time Clock User are fully non-editable.
evidence: Live roles API: destination system role exists = "Admin" (build name; case prose says Administrator), isEditable=true, 89 users, 42 perms. Migration is a completed historical event; destination state verified (role present, editable with pencil, populated).
